fields.title: Dew/frost rate and retention
fields.finding: Large-sphere convection, Lewis analogy, grey sky, constant capacities, nucleation, droplet pinning, emissivity under wetting and the cold frost scenario are unmeasured. All deposition is retained. Constant-climate dry-start results do not predict a wet-start transient.
